answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by charging every new identity a layered cost: an upfront token stake that burns on abuse, a proof-of-work puzzle tied to hardware's own hardware, and a co-signature from established peers at risk. The stake deters forking, the puzzle forces real compute, and the co-signature binds newcomers into trust built slowly thread by thread. Mass forgery cannot wash away this structure — the river of fake identities drowns under compounding collateral while patient honest work earns its place.
